text.en:
The municipal council of the municipality of Bacolor, Province of Pampanga, is hereby
authorized to change the date of its local fiesta, designating the eighteenth day of November of each year for
the celebration thereof.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the same shall take effect on its
passage, m accordance with section one of Act Numbered Nineteen hundred and forty-five of the Philippine
Legislature.
Enacted, November 10, 1913.
